blocks.text: Let's look at this one. The quantity two plus five, plus x, equals x plus the quantity two plus five. Which property does it show?
There are parentheses, so associative is tempting. But look: the group 2 plus 5 never changes. It stays together.
The whole group and x simply traded places. Swapping the order is the commutative property.
So the answer is the commutative property.
Watch out for these traps. It isn't the associative property, because the grouping does not change. It isn't the distributive property, because nothing multiplies a sum.
